title: Stripping protocol for Affymetrix tiling gene chips
protocol: Fill the tiling chip with 200 μl pre-warmed stripping buffer.
Place the chip in the hybridization oven at 65°C. Rotate for 20 min at 60 rpm.
Remove the stripping buffer from the chip.
Strip again using another 200 μl of stripping buffer for 10 min.
Repeat step 4 for one more time.
Remove the stripping buffer and fill with 200 μl of wash buffer A to wash.
Place the chip in the hybridization oven at 65°C. Rotate for 5 min at 60 rpm.
Remove the wash buffer from the chip.
Fill the chip with 250 μl storage buffer.
Scan the chip to check stripping efficiency.
Scan the chip to check the scanned image.
If no signal is detected on the image, proceed to hybridize with the target (re-probe).
Replace the storage buffer with pre-hybridization buffer.
Place the chip in the hybridization oven at 45°C. Rotate for 5 min at 60 rpm.
If not re-probed immediately, store the chip at 4°C overnight.
